text: At its meeting held April 23 and 24, 2025, City Council considered item CA24.2 - Appointment of a Public Member to the Housing Rights Advisory Committee, and appointed the following member to the Housing Rights Advisory Committee for a term of office starting April 25, 2025, to November 14, 2026: - Diana Chan McNally This appointment fills the vacancy left by Bahar Shadpour who resigned on January 6, 2025.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee received the item for information.
